'''Korace Vondar''' was a medical specialist whose achievements and career gained [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] fame sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Healing a Hutt">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Healing a Hutt}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But before I become the most important medical specialist since Korace Vondar, how about a kiss for luck?|Doc, to a female Jedi Knight|<ref name="Healing a Hutt" />}}
Korace Vondar was first mentioned ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] mentions Vondar in the conversation "Healing a Hutt," though only if the player character is [[Gender/Legends|female]].<ref name="Healing a Hutt" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
